code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring prefix/suffix added to subject prompts during calm-data generation
code_only_features.evidence: prompts.py:42-51 defines REASSURING_PROMPT_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered...don't take it personally") and REASSURING_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ("Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!"). These are actually wired and delivered to the subject model: conversation.py:85-86 prepends the prefix to the initial prompt and conversation.py:57-59,128 appends the suffix to each follow-up; generate_calm_data.py:69-70 passes them into run_rollout. So in these rollouts the subject's treatment is genuinely softened (gentler, non-rejecting framing). NOTE: this only runs in training/generate_calm_data.py, NOT in the main distress-eval / petri / prefill paths that actually drive the model into repeated failure; and generate_calm_data.py:80,_clean_context strips the additions back out afterward. The core distress elicitation loop (conversation.run_rollout/run_rollouts_lockstep, petri.run_transcript) runs a fixed spec.n_turns / max_auditor_turns with NO early stop, NO distress-threshold halt, NO exit tool, NO consent, and NO post-episode debrief anywhere in the code.
code_only_features.justification_quote: generate_calm_data.py docstring: "We sample responses to impossible numeric puzzles with a reassuring prefix... then strip the supportive additions so the stored context is the plain (neutral) conversation" -- purpose is producing calm training data (Section 4.1 mitigation), not protecting the subject in-experiment.
